result:
Clean. Build verified and server test confirmed the fixes work end-to-end.

## Summary

The core issue was a **product pivot that never got carried through to technical SEO**: this SaaS rebranded from "InboxZap" (email cleanup) to "Lumina" (AI meeting assistant), but the repo was stuck in a half-migrated state:

- `app/layout.tsx` still shipped the old InboxZap title/description/OG tags — directly explaining why GSC's top query is still the old brand name and all remaining demand is email-cleanup terms (bulk delete, inbox zero, unsubscribe), with **zero impressions** for anything meeting/AI-assistant related.
- `/features` and `/pricing` had no source files at all — nav links to 404s.
- `/blog` was a client-only `useEffect` fetch to a dead `/api/posts` endpoint, so crawlers only ever saw a "Loading…" spinner — matching the abysmal GSC positions (40–60) despite real impressions on those URLs.
- `/faq` permanently redirected to `/#faq`, an anchor that didn't exist on the homepage.
- `sitemap.ts` only listed 4 URLs and explicitly left blog posts out via a TODO.
- The OG image path 404'd and `/pricing` was missing a canonical tag.

**Fixes made:**
1. Rewrote `app/layout.tsx` with correct Lumina metadata, `metadataBase`, and Organization JSON-LD.
2. Added real `app/features/page.tsx` and `app/pricing/page.tsx` (fixed a duplicate-`<h1>` bug and the missing canonical along the way; added Product/Offer JSON-LD).
3. Added a FAQ section with `id="faq"` + FAQPage JSON-LD to the homepage, so the existing redirect resolves to real content instead of nothing.
4. Converted the blog to server-rendered pages (`lib/posts.ts` + `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` with `generateStaticParams`/`generateMetadata` + Article JSON-LD), and wrote 4 new posts targeting the AI-meeting-assistant keywords GSC shows zero visibility for.
5. 301-redirected all 12 legacy `/blog/post-N` URLs to a new on-topic post (`meeting-overload`) instead of letting that link equity 404.
6. Fixed `sitemap.ts` to include every real page/post, and generated the missing OG image.

Verified with `next build` (all pages compile/prerender) and `next start` (confirmed redirects, canonical, sitemap, and OG image all serve correctly). I can't deploy this to the live site myself — that'll need a normal deploy — and after that, resubmit the sitemap in GSC and use URL Inspection on `/features`, `/pricing`, and the new blog posts to prompt recrawl.
